name: Arkansas Card Show
blurb: A trading-card and collectibles show at the Statehouse Convention Center in Little Rock, run by VXV Events.
notes: vxvevents.com/events keeps a combined '2026 Events' / '2027 Events' calendar in plain text (fetched and cross-checked twice); the 2027 section runs Central Carolina Comic Con through Illinois Comic Con and does not include Arkansas Card Show, so no 2026-10-05..2027-12-31 date is announced yet (editions: []). Its last confirmed run was April 18-19, 2026 at the Statehouse Convention Center, Little Rock. A trading-card/collectibles show with no celebrity guest program (VXV's site has no Guests/Celebrities page for any of its shows).
